items.title: Example case study: keeping a project easy to inspect
items.summary: An example showing the shape of a case study. Replace it with a real one in Admin > Settings.
problem: Example: a project grows and nobody can tell how big it is or how it changed.
constraints: Example: no new tooling, and the numbers must be checkable by anyone with the repository.
solution: Example: keep history in small commits and every database change in a numbered migration, then measure with plain commands.

results.label: Lines in the backend build file

ifRedone: Example: I would record each measurement together with its command from the start, so the numbers never go stale.
